title: F07 · broken_phone · The Throw
lines: One bad game. One second of anger.
It was not even his phone. It was his father's old one.
What it broke was still there.
Dadi did not scold him. She told him about the day Shiva threw his own anger into the sea.
It did not vanish, she said. It grew up and came back.
"It did not vanish," she said. "It grew up and came back."
Kabir took the phone to his father himself,
Anger does not disappear when you throw it. Own it while it is small. That is sadhana.
